units: <cite ref="Berakhot 61b:11">Ber. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>במקים חַיּוּתֵנוּ</he> (<he>חַיּוּתֵינוּ</he>) in the element in which we live (the water).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:12">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> (play on <cite ref="H00266"><he>חַוָּה</he></cite>) <he>ניתנה לו לחַיּוּתוֹ וכ׳</he> she had been given to him for his strength, but she advised him like a serpent; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="H00690"><he>חַיּוֹת</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="H00691">next w.</cite>
